title: Northanger Abbey
author: Jane Austen
summary: Catherine Morland, a young woman who loves Gothic novels, visits Bath and then Northanger Abbey. There she imagines sinister secrets, while her real troubles are friendship and love, with the clever Henry Tilney.
readIf: you like Jane Austen's lightest, most playful satire of novel-reading.
skipIf: you want a deep romance, since the plot is slighter than her later novels.
